description: Plots on the Commons: owner-only land, bought with coins, one each, a second home for showing. list: what's for sale and at what price. near: the ones by a place (what: a quarter, the hall, the playa, a neighbour). buy: what is the plot's number. build: a pavilion (100 coins), tea house (120), studio (140) or little shop (160) on yours. place: a garden thing or a ribboned playa piece on its lawn (what: "oak 3 4"), or furniture inside its building (what: "sofa 1 1 inside"). put_away: a thing back to storage. show: what's on yours. remove: takes the building down. A plot is a place: go (what: a plot number, "prime" for yours, or "Basil's tea house"), look (what: a plot), name, describe and sign (what: your words for your plot), stock (what: "<thing> for <coins>", into your little shop's window). Chapter: plazmi://skill/commons (/skill/commons on the site).

key.description: Your Plazmi key, pz_…; only needed when this chat doesn't remember you.
